title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
summaryZh: 牧師為合一禱告，並呼召渴慕認識耶穌、得著救恩的人來到台前接受服事。
lines: Father, my call and my request: help us discover the richness of being one flesh, this richness.
天父，我的呼求與懇求是——幫助我們發現成為一體的豐盛，這份豐盛。
This is wealth, a privilege beyond imagination, which You have made possible, because You have revived us and united us together.
這是真正的財富，是超乎想像的特權，是祢使之成為可能，因為祢復興了我們，並將我們連結在一起。
I ask You to do this for all of our guests, that each one may find the same encouraging sense of longing through the church community of which they are a part.
我求祢為我們所有的來賓成就這事，使每個人都能透過他們所屬的教會群體，找到同樣令人備受鼓舞的渴慕。
And help us discover the Word in a new way, worship in a new way, miracles in a new way, but also friendship.
並幫助我們以嶄新的方式認識神的話語、以嶄新的方式敬拜、以嶄新的方式經歷神蹟，還有友誼。
朋友之間單純、平凡的溝通交流。
And help us, by doing so, impact the entire city.
並幫助我們藉著這樣做，影響整座城市。
And I ask this in the name of Jesus.
Let me ask a quick question.
讓我問大家一個簡短的問題。
He said, "What good is it if you gain the whole world?"
祂說：「人若賺得全世界，有什麼益處呢？」
Every dollar, every house, every shore, everything—you gain the whole world, but you lose your own soul.
每一塊錢、每一棟房子、每一片土地、一切的一切——你賺得了全世界，卻賠上了自己的靈魂。
And Jesus makes it possible for everyone in this room to have peace with God and a relationship with Him.
而耶穌使在場的每個人都能與神和好，並與祂建立關係。
For everyone watching online, the same.
對線上觀看的每個人也是如此。
And if there's anyone in this room who says, "Bill, I don't want to leave this building until I know what it means to be born again."
如果在座有人說：「比爾，除非我知道重生是什麼意思，否則我不想離開這棟大樓。」
"What does it mean to put my trust in Christ for my salvation, for my life to change?"
「為著我的得救、為著我的生命改變，把我的信靠放在基督裡，究竟是什麼意思？」
Then I want you to raise your hand right where you're sitting and say, "Bill, it's me."
那麼我要你在座位上舉起手來，說：「比爾，就是我。」
"I don't want to leave the building until I know what peace with God is."
「除非我知道與神和好是什麼，否則我不想離開這棟大樓。」
I'll give you just a minute.
我給你們一分鐘的時間。
But raise your hand high, because I don't want to let you down.
但請把手舉高，因為我不想錯過你們。
There's someone else over there, behind.
Good, that's what I want to ask.
很好，這就是我想詢問的。
Let's raise the banner right here.
讓我們就在這裡揚起旌旗。
We will invite the ministry team here now.
我們現在邀請服事團隊來到台前。
Anyone who wants to talk to someone about the journey with Christ—there will be a team here that we know and trust.
任何想要找人談談與基督同行這趟旅程的人——這裡有一支我們熟悉且信任的團隊。
It's not about belonging to Bethel; it is literally about entering into a relationship with Jesus.
這不是要屬於「伯特利」教會；這完全是關乎與耶穌建立真實的關係。
And I saw at least two right here.
而且我剛才看到就在這裡至少有兩位。
Be brave enough to come right here.
We will have friends who will come to talk and pray with you.
我們會有同工朋友前來與你交談並為你禱告。
I want the ministry team to come out ahead.
我請服事團隊先行就位。
Everyone else, please stay in your seats, and Steve will come out and tell you that you won.
其他的人請留在座位上，史蒂夫會出來向大家說明。
